notes.title: UPDATE #11 - Tracker Boar!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Hunters![/b]

One of the more common feedback items we receive is about the tracking process and how it feels a bit... rudimentary. Previously, you would just find a bone pile, interact with it and that would show you which direction to walk in. It was functional but it was never really particularly interesting. We've actually gone through a number of iterations for tracking, and while they worked they never felt great.

Today we welcome the newest recruit to Hunters, Inc. PORKY - THE TRACKING BOAR!

Porky is an AI companion that will help you track down the target in no time. Simply find a clue in the existing bone piles and give it to Porky. Once he has the scent he will track down the monster and all you need to do is follow. As a rookie he can occasionally get confused, but we have high hopes for him and look forward to seeing him in action!

Here is a list of everything we have added in Update #11:

[h2]NEW FEATURES[/h2]

[h3]TRACKER BOAR![/h3]
[list]
[*] Tracking boar now spawns with you at the start of the mission
[*] Destroy bone pile to find monster remains that can be given to the boar
[*] Boar will pick up the scent of the monster (! over its head)
[*] Boar will show ??? when trail is lost
[*] Can keep giving him monster clue bones until target monster(s) are found
[*] Boar can take a real beating, but isn't invulnerable (yet)
[*] Boar can be picked up and thrown - useful if it gets stuck
[*] When mission ends boar will path back to airship
[/list]

[h2]UPDATES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

notes.title: UPDATE #10 - Mutation Events!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Hunters![/b]

In this update we wanted to focus on improving the replayability of the game by changing up the mission parameters each time you load into a hunt. The levels are already procedurally generated, meaning their layout changes each time you play, but we also wanted to mix up the gameplay by adding mutators.

The world of Hunters, Inc. is constantly at risk from a malevolent corrupting force. This force can effect anything in the game world; from big boss monsters to traps or even the world itself. When looking at missions on the map table you will see that some (not all) of the available missions have been exposed to this corruption.

Where does this corruption come from, and more importantly, how does it affect the guilds Q3 cash flow projections? Who knows!? That is the guild masters problem. Your problem is figuring out how to deal with this new menace!

As always, please let us know you think about this update here in the forums or over in our [url=https://discord.gg/mymMFUCrye]Discord Channel[/url]. Your feedback really helps us identify the areas that need improvment and what to work on next.

notes.title: Join the Hunt! Hunters, Inc. Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Hunters![/b]

Big News - The demo for Hunters, Inc. is out now! In this demo you'll get to experience:

[list]
[*] Full co-op functionality - up to 4 players
[*] Tutorial to teach you the fundamentals of hunting
[*] Full access to the first biome
[*] 2 mission types - Boss Hunt and Extermination
[*] Monster dismemberment and crafting parts
[*] Upgrade for each class up to the first 2 tiers for primary weapons.
[/list]

We'd like to say a big thank you to everyone that has taken part in the playtest so far. Your feedback and suggestions have really helped us identify areas of the game that needed improvement and it has come along way since our very first closed alpha.

Now the demo is out, there will be a few changes to how we conduct playtests - most notably we will be moving into [b]closed beta[/b]. Anyone with existing access to the playtest app will periodically be invited to join in scheduled playtest sessions to try out new features and content. These playtests will be less frequent than our current update schedule, but contain bigger, meatier updates and only run for a fixed period of time. For example, we might run a 2 week playtest to try out a new biome, with all new monsters and hazards.

As always, please let us know your thoughts on the changes here in the forums or over in our [url=https://discord.gg/mymMFUCrye]Discord Channel[/url]

Thanks again for all your support and can't wait to see what you think of the demo!

We're back with a new enemy and new mission type and an exciting update to the end of round extraction event. We hope that this will address the feedback that extraction felt a little anti-climactic in its previous incarnation and up the ante when it comes to getting out with those valuable monster parts!

In addition to adding new gameplay features we also spent alot of time improving the lighting and performance of the game. This should make the game look better and make combat and navigation feel *even* snappier. In this milestone we also carried out a big overhaul of the mission spawning logic giving us more control over where, when and how enemies spawn in the world!

notes.title: OPEN ALPHA: UPDATE #6 - New Classes!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Hunters![/b]

As some of you know, the Berserker has been the only playable class for a while. Mainly, this is because we wanted to iterate on the core monster tracking and fighting aspect of the game, and having fewer classes means it was easier for use to focus on and tune that experience. Essentially it removed a layer of complexity and allowed us to rule out class asymmetry and tuning as a potential cause of any issues.

Now that the core of the game is starting to come together, it is time for us to introduce the rest of the Hunters Inc team! 

This is still a very early "blocking out" of the classes for the game and is nowhere near final. Over time the classes will start to take on much more distinct characteristics. Abilities and weapons will evolve, swap between classes, or may even disappear entirely! There are a fair few placeholder mechanics to try and emulate the behaviour we want and lack of polish around the new weapons, but we wanted to get it into your hands as soon as possible. Please let us know your thoughts on the new classes either here in the forums or over in our [url=https://discord.gg/mymMFUCrye]Discord Channel[/url]

[*] Hunter vision. Each class now has its own unique hunter vision bound to Q.
[*] Ammo crates. Restore ammo for ranged weapons and grenades. Replaces bomb bushes.
[*] Item shop will only show purchasable items for selected class (Berserker only currently)
[*] Added HUD Widget for Hunter Vision
[/list]

[h3]NEW CLASS - TRACKER[/h3]
A low health, high stamina class whose job is to locate the monster and identify it's weakspots for the rest of the team. Deals low damage from range but can inflict huge damage to weak spots.
[list]
[*] New Weapon - Bow! Hold Left click to charge a shot. Right click to perform a weak melee
[*] New Weapon - Dagger! Left click to stab, Right click to unleash a wild stab frenzy
[*] New Weapon - Smoke Bombs! Throw smoke bombs on yourself or team mates to reduce the aggro level of anyone inside the smoke. Useful for escapes!
[*] Hunter Vision - Weakspots. Identify the location monster weakspots for the rest of the team
[*] Hunter Vision - Footprints. Relocating monsters leave tracks that can be seen by the tracker.
[/list]

[h3]NEW CLASS - SHAMAN[/h3]
A low health, low stamina support class who can provide intel on monster behaviour and manage team and enemy status effects.
[list]
[*] New Weapon - Scythe! Left click to slash, Right click to perform a charge attack
[*] New Weapon - Magic Skull! Left click to release a continuous jet of magic flame. Right click to perform a melee strike
[*] New Weapon - Wisp! Throw the wisp and follow its trail to find the monster
[*] Hunter Vision - Creature Health. See the health of monsters and mobs, green is healthy, red is close to death.
[*] Hunter Vision - Monster Aggro. Visualises which Hunter currently has the monsters attention by drawing a red line from monster to target.
[/list]

[h3]NEW CLASS - BLACKSMITH[/h3]
A medium health, medium stamina class that specialises in structures and equipment. Can deal high damage to hard targets like monster armor, structures and environmental objects.
[list]
[*] New Weapon - Hammer! Left click to swing, Right click to perform charged smash attack.
[*] New Weapon - Blunderbuss! Left click to blast, right click to melee with rifle butt.
[*] New Weapon - Flash Bang! Throw at monsters to stun them!
[*] Hunter Vision - Items. Hunter tools and items are highlighted in the world.
[*] Hunter Vision - Breakables. See which objects in the game world can be destroyed by players or monsters.
[/list]

[h2]UPDATES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

[*] Update HUD portraits to accurately reflect class
[*] Can no longer pick up, or see pickup prompt, for thrown items that don't belong to your class
[*] Removed level gate for spider queen battle
[*] Moved class select station to inside the barracks
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]

[/list]

[h2]KNOWN ISSUES[/h2]

After analyzing hundreds of individual feedback items, a pattern quickly started to emerge. The two most common pieces of feedback we're around how it felt to control the Orcs and tedium of tracking the monster around the map. 

So with this update we set out to improve those areas of the game - namely by giving the orcs 2 new mobility mechanics (including the highly requested ability to sprint) and a super jump. Let us know what you think of the improvements!

notes.title: CLOSED ALPHA: UPDATE #4 - RAZAN HUNT
notes.content:
Greetings Hunters!

For Update #4 we have focused on significantly improving the experience of fighting our first boss monster and improving the difficulty level of the game.

Some of you may remember the predecessor to Razan, the crocodile formerly known as the Sandsnapper. Razan is the first boss we started working on, and it has gone through a number of iterations. In this update we made significant improvements to boss encounters and want to start giving the monsters a life and personality of their own - hence the name change!

[b]Razan[/b] is a giant lizard that inhabits the sulphur plains. Thematically it is all about acid and uses its acid immunity to hunt down and destroy its prey. While hunting it, you will need to avoid its acid pools, be mindful of how close you are to melting your armor and avoid its acidic bile projectiles. Killing the Razan will give you the crafting materials need to upgrade your weapons with acidic properties that will be useful against other boss monsters.

We hope you enjoy it - as always if you like to talk with us or have any questions about the game, we look forward to chatting with you on our [url=https://discord.gg/mymMFUCrye]Discord Channel[/url]



[h2]NEW FEATURES[/h2]

[h3]Razan Hunt[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tuned mission to have a single, significantly tougher monster (was previously 3 small monsters)
[*] Added new direct acid spit attack
[*] Acid no longer does immediate damage, instead applies the acid status effect
[*] Reduced duration and size of spawned acid pools
[*] Killing Razan unlocks an acid upgrade for the sword that applies acid status effect to enemies
[/list]

[h3]Boss Monster Behaviour[/h3]
[list]
[*] Monsters can now relocate to a new area on the map when they reach a certain damage threshold
[*] Boss will throw players off their back when relocating
[*] Monsters can now become enraged - increasing attack speed and damage for a fixed period of time
[*] Monsters can now break through objects when relocating to a new area
[/list]

[h3]Game Difficulty[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added system to dynamically scale difficulty based on player count (updates every time a player leaves / joins a hunt)
[*] Solo players now have 3 lives. Being knocked out will respawn you back at base camp.
[*] Reduced Spider Queen to 3 from 4
[*] Reduced number of spiders spawned during Spider Queen hunt
[*] Scale number of mob spiders based on player count
[/list]

[h3]Status Effects[/h3]
[list]
[*] Implemented a feature where status effects are applied after X seconds of build up, and then trigger an event upon filling the bar. 
[i]In this update standing in acid pools will cause ACID BURN to accumulate, trigger damage over time when the bar reaches max. Stay out of acid for X seconds to make the bar start dissapating.[/i]
[/list]

[h3]Other Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an "Unstuck" button to manually respawn players at camp. Will not be in shipping game but intended to reduce the need to restart missions in the event of bugs during pre-release. Might by glitchy
[/list]


[h2]Other Updates and Improvements[/h2]

[h3]World & Hub[/h3]

[*] Increase skirt on nav mesh to improve monster pathing
[*] Pass of boss monster spawn locations
[*] Pass of all world modules adding more collectibles
[*] Decoration pass on all world modules
[*] Added placeholder class selection station to hub
[*] Fixed collision issues in hub
[/list]

[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]

[*] Reduced spear count to 3 and increase the damage they do

[*] Make Tracking Bone Pile bigger and more obvious
[*] Increased Aggro range on spider

[*] Improved wall jump
[*] Made breakable objects able to be mantled up

[/list]

[*] Updated main menu w/ new logo, background and buttons
[*] Updated upsell screen

[*] Updated avatar icons in HUD
[*] Updated loading screen images
[*] Updated mission preview image for Spider Queen mission
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: HOTFIX: Spider Queen Map
notes.content:
Greetings Hunters!

Previously the Spider Queen hunt had been using a very work in progress variant of our map generation system that we had been experimenting with. As a result, it was very large and very empty. 

We have now reverted it back to using the standard map generation logic meaning it will be:

[list]
[*] Smaller
[*] Easier to navigate
[*] Properly decorated
[*] Have more stuff to interact with
[/list]


We wanted to get a hotfix out ASAP as players had a 50% chance of picking the Spider Queen Hunt as their first experience with Hunters Inc and it wasn't particularly reflective of the regular map layout.

Happy Hunting!
